paragraphs.text: Kraum , Ludevic's Opus , is a legendary zombie horror from Innistrad .

Kraum was created by the infamous necro-alchemist Ludevic , who considers Kraum his work of genius and has spent almost a decade trying to replicate it. Kraum flies on galvanic membranes, its approach heralded by bursts of static pops and the endless cackling of one of its two hideous heads. Since it is a regular sight above the rooftops of Selhoff , Kraum's terrifying presence has made its creator a wanted man among the residents of the seaside town.
Concerned for his apprentice's welfare, Ludevic of Ulm sent Kraum to Thunder Junction to make sure Geralf Cecani got into the right kind of trouble.
